nodes.label: WS /printers/{id}/camera/mse — go2rtc MSE relay for viewers that cannot reach…

go2rtc's /api/ws: replays scripted frames once the MSE request arrives.
go2rtc's /api/ws also speaks webrtc/offer, hls, mp4, mjpeg… — the relay exists…
